noveltyPosition: The cycle does not claim to invent early-life battery prediction, domain adaptation, active learning, hierarchical transfer, support diagnostics, or conformal prediction. It tests a preregistered composition—forced leave-source-out evaluation, support-aware abstention, and a two-cell target-domain offset—on four current BatteryLife v11 sources.

sources.title: BatteryLife: A Comprehensive Dataset and Benchmark for Battery Life Prediction
sources.usedFor: Defines the cross-dataset benchmark, standardized records, and documented difficulty of transfer and domain adaptation.
sources.doesNotEstablish: It does not validate the registered support gate or two-cell passport on the four RC52 sources.

sources.title: BatteryLife_Processed v11
sources.usedFor: Provides the exact processed archives, labels, READMEs, version date, and archive checksums.
sources.doesNotEstablish: A data release does not establish transport accuracy or mechanistic validity.

sources.title: BatteryLife v11 update details
sources.usedFor: Records corrected CALB charge capacity and life labels, making older-version results non-equivalent.
sources.doesNotEstablish: The correction notice does not quantify downstream prediction changes.

sources.title: Limits of electrochemical data for predicting battery lifetime and failure
sources.usedFor: Shows why electrical histories can be necessary yet insufficient for reservoir depletion, mechanical thresholds, and latent localized defects.
sources.doesNotEstablish: It does not measure RC52 cross-source errors; its impossibility boundary is retained even if prediction metrics look good.

sources.title: Discovery Learning predicts battery cycle life from minimal experiments
sources.usedFor: Demonstrates an active, physics-guided, zero-shot/few-experiment route on 123 industrial pouch cells and reports 7.2% test error after 50 cycles on 51% of prototypes.
sources.doesNotEstablish: Its target design, selected prototypes, physical features, and 50-cycle horizon differ from RC52's four-source 20-cycle audit.

sources.title: Predicting battery lifetime under varying usage conditions from early aging data
sources.usedFor: Reports 15.1% in-distribution MAPE and 21.8% out-of-distribution MAPE with degradation-informed features and a hierarchical Bayesian model on 225 cells.
sources.doesNotEstablish: A controlled NMC/graphite stress matrix does not establish transfer between RC52 laboratories, formats, capacities, and label conventions.

sources.title: Data-driven prediction of battery cycle life before capacity degradation
sources.usedFor: Establishes that early voltage-curve features can predict cycle life within a deliberately generated 124-cell LFP/graphite fast-charge study.
sources.doesNotEstablish: Its 9.1% reported test error does not imply new-source or cross-chemistry transfer.

sources.title: Principles of the Battery Data Genome
sources.usedFor: Frames minimum observation length, use-scenario transfer, chemistry transfer, uncertainty, and standardized data as open program-level questions.
sources.doesNotEstablish: A roadmap does not supply a validated prediction rule or coverage guarantee.

sources.title: Intrinsic Variability in the Degradation of a Batch of Commercial 18650 Lithium-Ion Cells
sources.usedFor: Documents growing degradation variability in nominally similar HNEI cells and the weak relation between initial variation and durability.
sources.doesNotEstablish: One batch does not determine cross-source transport.

sources.title: Predicting the impact of formation protocols on battery lifetime immediately after manufacturing
sources.usedFor: Identifies low-SOC resistance after formation as a rapid signal linked to lithium consumption and later life in the MICH experiment.
sources.doesNotEstablish: RC52 lacks the registered low-SOC resistance modality and therefore cannot reproduce or refute that mechanism.

sources.title: Degradation-Safety Analytics in Lithium-Ion Cells: Part I. Aging under Charge/Discharge Cycling
sources.usedFor: Supplies the UL-PUR cycling study and links voltage-window changes with capacity-life and post-mortem degradation mechanisms.
sources.doesNotEstablish: Only two UL-PUR cells have official v11 life labels in the downloaded subset, preventing a source-level population claim.

sources.title: Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
sources.usedFor: Shows that coverage under covariate shift requires weighted exchangeability, specifically stable conditional outcomes and a known or well-estimated test-to-train covariate likelihood ratio.
sources.doesNotEstablish: Battery source shift may change the conditional lifetime law, so RC52 reports empirical intervals and does not invoke the theorem's guarantee.

repositoryInheritance.inherited: The atlas already separates observable health indicators from hidden failure mechanisms and requires non-invasive validation.
repositoryInheritance.newBoundary: RC52 forces entire experimental sources out of training and tests abstention plus minimal target calibration.

repositoryInheritance.inherited: The atlas already treats a process–structure–property–lifetime twin as a transport and uncertainty problem rather than a visualization task.
repositoryInheritance.newBoundary: RC52 measures one narrow surrogate link—early cell history to lifetime—across design and laboratory domains; it does not create a full process twin.

repositoryInheritance.inherited: The atlas already requires accelerated tests to preserve mechanisms and path dependence before long-service claims.
repositoryInheritance.newBoundary: RC52 tests whether a fixed 20-cycle observation survives a source change and explicitly abstains when it does not.
